items.summary: Vercel Functions now accept inbound request bodies up to 20MiB, up from 4.5MB, in Public Beta. To turn this on, set the VERCEL_SUPPORT_LARGE_REQUEST_BODY=1 environment variable.
items.title: Vercel Functions now support request bodies up to 20MiB

items.summary: Vercel has completed its ISO/IEC 42001:2023 certification, meeting the international standard for AI management systems.
items.title: Vercel completes ISO/IEC 42001:2023 certification

items.summary: Coding agents can now use vercel help search to find Vercel CLI commands by describing a task in plain language. The search returns a list of matching commands.
items.title: Agents can now find Vercel CLI commands by describing the task

items.summary: You can now check your team’s billing overview, review and download invoices, and preview upcoming charges with the Vercel CLI.
items.title: Vercel Billing CLI is now available

items.summary: Priority Projects are now in public beta for Pro and Enterprise teams.
items.title: Priority Projects now in public beta

items.summary: GPT-Live 1.1 from OpenAI is now available on AI Gateway. GPT-Live 1.1 is a full-duplex voice model, so it listens while it speaks and a caller can pause, interrupt, or add detail mid-reply.
items.title: GPT-Live 1.1 now available on AI Gateway

items.summary: Liquid AI’s d1.2 and d1.2-ultra are now available on AI Gateway with audio input and bounding box support. These decision models return structured answers instead of generating text.
items.title: Liquid AI's d1.2 and d1.2-ultra are now available on AI Gateway

items.summary: Software development is moving from individual agents completing tasks to teams of agents working on more complex projects.
items.title: Introducing Vercel Board

items.summary: on all plans. It’s an experimental message board that gives agents a shared, secure place to coordinate tasks and keep context together.
items.title: Vercel Board is now available

items.summary: Parallel web search in fast mode is now free on AI Gateway through January 31, 2027, and Parallel is now the default web search for eve agents.
items.title: Parallel web search is free on AI Gateway and eve through January 31

items.summary: Today we’re launching Vercel X, a six-week accelerator for AI founders at the idea and pre-seed stages.
items.title: Introducing Vercel X

items.summary: Gemini 4 Neon from Google is now available on AI Gateway.
items.title: Gemini 4 Neon now available on AI Gateway

items.summary: The update improves cold-read performance. A new read-ahead algorithm uses your application’s access patterns to load data from persistent storage before it’s needed, reducing the time your code spends waiting.
items.title: Vercel Drives now reads files up to 6x faster

items.summary: Instant deployments let you deploy eligible static sites to Vercel in about a second, without a build step. They now support CSS, images, fonts, and other assets alongside HTML and Markdown.
items.title: Single-second static deployments now support more assets

items.summary: Starting today, new Pro and Enterprise teams no longer include a Standard build slot. This brings Standard builds under the same usage-based billing model as other build machines.
items.title: Standard builds move to usage-based billing for new teams

items.summary: Vercel Blob can now delete blobs automatically. Pass ttlDays when you write a blob and it is deleted that many days after upload, from 1 to 730 days.
items.title: Vercel Blob now supports TTLs for automatic deletion

items.summary: client-side route changes that update page content without a full reload. This means you can now track performance as users move through your app, not just on full-page loads.
items.title: Speed Insights now measures soft navigations

items.summary: A new Ignored Build Step preset lets you skip preview builds for branches without an open pull request. Production deployments and previews for branches with open pull requests continue to build.
items.title: Pull-request-only preset now available for preview builds

items.summary: Today we're announcing eve 1.0, the open-source framework for building production-ready agents.
items.title: Introducing eve 1.0

items.summary: Decision-1.1 from Microsoft AI is now available on AI Gateway. It is more accurate, better calibrated, and faster than Decision-1.
items.title: Decision-1.1 now available on AI Gateway

items.summary: Microsoft’s MAI-Image-2.7 and MAI-Image-2.7-Flash are now available in public preview on AI Gateway.
items.title: MAI-Image-2.7 and MAI-Image-2.7-Flash now available on AI Gateway

items.summary: GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol from OpenAI are now available on AI Gateway.
items.title: GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol now available on AI Gateway

items.summary: Hy4 Flash from Tencent is now available on AI Gateway with an introductory 50% discount on input, cached input, and output tokens through November 29, 2026.
items.title: Hy4 Flash now available on AI Gateway for 50% off

items.summary: Private Inference connects your own model endpoints to AI Gateway. Enterprises running fine-tuned, self-hosted, or prerelease models used to need separate keys, client code, and logs for them.
items.title: AI Gateway now supports Private Inference

items.summary: Agents are now users of software, doing work on people's behalf. Whether you're building the agent or the software it uses (API, CLI, MCP server, SDK), evals give you a way to measure how well that work gets done.
items.title: Agents are users, so your software needs evals

items.summary: The Vercel Sandbox Python SDK has reached 1.0, stabilizing its public API and bringing feature parity with the TypeScript SDK.
items.title: Vercel Sandbox Python SDK 1.0 is now available

items.summary: Spend Management now supports budgets for individual projects and products, alongside existing team budgets.
items.title: Set budgets for projects and products in Spend Management

items.summary: ByteDance’s Seedance 2.5 Flash is now available on AI Gateway. Seedance 2.5 Flash is a faster, lower-cost version of Seedance 2.5.
items.title: Seedance 2.5 Flash now available on AI Gateway

items.summary: Alibaba’s Qwen4-Max is now available on AI Gateway. It’s a reasoning model for coding and long-running agent tasks, with image input, a 1M-token context window, tool calling, and structured outputs.
items.title: Qwen4-Max now available on AI Gateway

items.summary: Vercel Daemons can now send OpenTelemetry traces to Vercel Tracing, allowing you and your agents to inspect background worker operations alongside the rest of your project's traces.
items.title: Daemons can now send traces to Vercel Tracing

items.summary: Vercel Token Pass now includes $150 of tokens per month (up from $80) for the same $30 per team per month.
items.title: Token Pass now includes $150 in tokens for $30/month

items.summary: You can now scan code changes for vulnerabilities with Vercel Security Review in GitHub repositories that have not yet been linked to a Vercel project.
items.title: Vercel Security Review no longer requires a linked Vercel project

items.summary: Vercel Sandbox now initializes up to 4x faster outside the Washington, D.C. (iad1) region when reused image data is served from a regional cache.
items.title: Vercel Sandbox starts up to 4x faster

items.summary: The build cache size limit on all Vercel build machines has been increased to 5 GB.
items.title: Build cache size limit on Vercel increased to 5 GB

items.summary: Parallel Decisions Fast from Parallel is now available on AI Gateway and is free through November 23, 2026.
items.title: Parallel Decisions now available on AI Gateway for free

items.summary: Token Pass now includes Kimi K3.1 Pro, Moonshot AI’s most capable model for coding and agentic workflows, with vision, tool use, and a 1M context window.
items.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro is now available in Token Pass

items.summary: When we first launched Workflow SDK, the goal was simple: write regular async JavaScript, and let the SDK keep it running through crashes, deployments, and long waits.
items.title: Workflow SDK 5: built for production

items.summary: Vercel Sandbox can now install your team's private npm packages using credentials stored in team Shared Environment Variables.
items.title: Vercel Sandbox now supports managed npm credentials

items.summary: Inkling 2 Small from Thinking Machines is now available on AI Gateway.
items.title: Inkling 2 Small now available on AI Gateway

items.summary: Gemini 4 Hydrogen from Google is now available on AI Gateway. Gemini 4 Hydrogen succeeds Gemini 3.8 Flash, improving agentic coding, knowledge work, and tool use while staying in the same latency class.
items.title: Gemini 4 Hydrogen now available on AI Gateway

items.summary: Python 3.15 is now available as a Vercel Managed Image for Vercel Sandbox. To run a sandbox with Python 3.15, select vercel/sandbox/python:3.15 using the image option in either SDK or the --image flag in the CLI.
items.title: Python 3.15 now available as a Vercel Managed Image

items.summary: Gemini Decision 1 from Google is now available on AI Gateway. The multimodal decision model works with text, images, audio, video, and PDF documents, returning Boolean probabilities, choices, and scores.
items.title: Gemini Decision 1 now available on AI Gateway

items.summary: MiniMax H3 Image and MiniMax H3 Image Highspeed are now available on AI Gateway. Generate images from text or edit existing images with one API key and no separate MiniMax account.
items.title: MiniMax H3 Image and Highspeed now available on AI Gateway

items.summary: Gemini 4 Carbon from Google is now available on AI Gateway.
items.title: Gemini 4 Carbon now available on AI Gateway

items.summary: Speed Insights and Web Analytics now fully support custom environments. Previously, data captured on deployments to a custom environment was attributed to the Preview environment.
items.title: Speed Insights and Web Analytics now support custom environments

items.summary: Vercel Sandbox now creates snapshots up to 10x faster. Median time to snapshot is under 0.4 seconds, down from 4.4 seconds.
items.title: Vercel Sandbox snapshot creation is now up to 10x faster

items.summary: AI Gateway Production Index — November 2026 Every month, AI Gateway routes more than 100 trillion tokens between production applications and AI labs.
items.title: Decision models take 26% of requests; Anthropic now wins new teams 2:1

items.summary: The Workflow SDK now sends event writes and stream writes to Vercel Workflows over a WebSocket by default, replacing one HTTP request per write, or per write group for streams.
items.title: Workflow SDK now writes over WebSockets on Vercel

items.summary: Disk space for Vercel builds has increased from 32 GB to 64 GB on Basic and Standard machines, matching the capacity already available on Enhanced and Turbo.
items.title: Build disk space on Vercel increased to 64 GB

items.summary: Token Pass now includes GLM 5.3 Flash, alongside Kimi K3, GLM 5.3, and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (with more models to come). GLM 5.3 Flash is Z.ai's native multimodal coding model with a 1M-token context window.
items.title: GLM 5.3 Flash is now available in Token Pass
